text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While doing roadwork for morning practice
with Meisho Doto through the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto tripped on something and stumbled.
—Looking over, a pair of trouser-clad legs was sticking out
from underneath a parked truck.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"A-Ah-wa-wa-wa it's an emergency, Trainerrr!
Someone collapsed over hereee! A-An ambulance!!"

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I'm fine!
I just crawled under the car to check for breakdowns!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Is that what it was?
I'm so glad everything's alright~

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text:
"...No, it's a huge problem, actually.
My truck broke down, so I won't make the delivery in time.
It's the meat for the Tracen Academy cafeteria..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh... At the academy...?
If today's lunch doesn't have meat,
that's going to be a huge disaster~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, arranging a replacement vehicle would take too long.
Given the sheer amount of cargo, transporting it by taxi was deemed out of the question as well.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Umm, would it be alright
if I carried that meat...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I am an Umamusume after all, so I'm pretty strong, and I think my running has gotten faster lately, so...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I might be clumsy, but...
Even so, I'll do my absolute best to run
so we make it in time if anything happens...!
choice_data_list: ...What's got into you all of a sudden?
...What's got into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, I was clumsy before and spilled
food in the cafeteria...
I caused so much trouble for everyone..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
“Still, no one got mad at all...
They were so kind to me... and yet, I feel so, so pathetic
for being unable to give anything back...!”

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That's why... to make up for not being able to do anything back then,
I wanna do my beeeeest!
Please let me help out~~!!

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text:
...All right!
If you insist, I'll leave it to you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Meisho Doto ended up hauling the cargo container to Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Then I'll go ahead and... huh, Mr. Tanuki?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Where are you going...? Could it be
you're showing me a shortcut~?

text_block_list.name: Tanuki
text_block_list.text: Whuff, whuff...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*, *pant*... Ugh, it's so heavy...
But I gotta keep going...

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof woof! Bark bark bark!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah, sorry, little doggy!
We're blocking the way... We'll move right aside!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm slipp... WHOAAAAAA!!
I can't sto~o~o~p on this slooooooope~~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Phewww~... Somehow, we, made it~.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Doto-chan!
Tazuna-san told me about it, and I was surprised,
but you really carried it all by yourself, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah... From the cafeteria...!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Truly... thank you.
Thanks to you, I can serve up the menu just as planned!
Make sure you eat your fill for lunch, okay!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe, thank goodness...!
I wonder if I was able to repay your kindness, even just a little...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*, *pant*... Those stairs were brutal...
Let's take a short break... put down the meat—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RAT-TAT-TAT-TAT-TAT-TAT!!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah-wa-wa-wa wait, wait, waaaait!! The meat is going down the stairs! It's gonna fall~~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Phewww~... T-That was heavy...
B-But, we somehow made it~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Happy come come, the meat has arrived!
Wait, not meat... Doto-san!
I have been eagerly awaiting you!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Feh? F-Fukukitaru-san?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Maaa'aaam! The meat's arrived!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, great work, Doto-chan!
I was surprised when Tazuna-san told me,
but you really carried all of it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Doto-san, thank you from me as well!
Thanks to you, it looks like I'll be able to eat today's lucky menu item, katsu curry!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Is that so~?
Ehehe, I'm so glad~.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Doto-chan.
Thanks to you, we can serve the menu just as planned!
Make sure to eat your fill for lunch, okay?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! I'm so looking forward to lunch~!
Maybe I'll go with katsu curry today too, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*Pant, pant*... Ugh, so heavy...
I've gotta be careful not to bump it against the trees...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyowaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ow ow... I fell down...
I wasn't watching my step at all...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... As expected, was it too reckless
for someone clumsy and useless like meee...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm so so so sorry...! I-I've gone and made the same blunder again...
Ugh... uwaaaaahhhh...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
"Don't be so down.
You look terribly exhausted...
We've gotta eat a bunch and build your strength back up!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Still... I gotta try my best...
Doing my best is all I can do, after all.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Phewww~... S-Somehow, we made it~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Meisho Doto.
I heard from the delivery driver.
You did well delivering it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fwaaa~, M-Madam President, please,
that's way too much honor for meee~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, the entire student body will be grateful for your hard work.
On behalf of all the students, I thank you. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
It's just like the President said! Thank you!
Thanks to you, we can serve our planned menu.
Be sure to eat your fill for lunch, okay!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone...
...H-Huuu, uuughhh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Thank you so much~!
Uuu, I'm so glad I worked hard for this~!!
